messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "use only the injection pen that comes with insulin glargine"
set: ["use only the injection pen that comes with insulin glargine", "Insulin glargine", "use the dropper that comes with the concentrated solution", "injection only", "syringe or insulin pen", "do not store an injection pen with the needle attached", "use only for the indication prescribed", "Insulin or other diabetes medicines that raise insulin", "do not transfer the insulin from the pen into a syringe", "subcutaneous injection using pre-filled single-dose pen", "measure with marked oral syringe, dosing spoon, or medicine cup that comes with it", "use the dropper supplied with the bottle", "each injection is pre-filled and intended for use by one patient only", "never share an injection pen even if you changed the needle", "insulin", "use an injection on the same day each week"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
